sloka: यदा हि प्रीतिसंयोगं त्वया विष्णो समागतः ।तदाप्रभृति लोकानां नाथत्वमुपलब्धवान् ।। ७.८४.१५ ॥
transliteration: yadā hi prītisaṁyogaṁ tvayā viṣṇo samāgataḥ ।tadāprabhṛti lokānāṁ nāthatvamupalabdhavān ।। 7.84.15 ॥

translations.english: Indeed, it was when he obtained your favor, O Vishnu, that he achieved lordship over the worlds from that time onwards.
